 Dated this the 2nd day of June, 2025  ORDER
This bail application is filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.369 of 2025 of Parassala Police Station,
Thiruvananthapuram, registered for the offence punishable under section 376 of the IPC.

3. According to the prosecution, the accused had, under the pretext of a romantic relationship,
subjected the victim to sexual intercourse and impregnated her and thereafter refused to marry her and thereby committed the offences alleged.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the entire prosecution allegations are false,
and the petitioner was arrested on 03.03.2025, and he has been in custody since then.
6. The learned Public Prosecutor, upon instructions, submitted that the petitioner was married even at the time he maintained a relationship with the victim and also had a child in the said marriage.
2025:KER:38405
Subsequently, after the victim became pregnant, she also delivered a child.

It is also submitted that the conduct of the petitioner does not deserve any leniency and that his continued detention is essential despite the Final Report having been filed on 31.05.2025.
7.
The petitioner has been in custody for the last more than 90 days.
The Final Report has been filed.
Petitioner is a young person of 24 years in age.
Petitioner is already married and has a child, and due to the crisis alleged, the victim has also given birth to a child.

Though the allegations against the petitioner are serious, considering the period of detention already undergone and also the young age of the petitioner, I am of the view that the continued detention of the petitioner is not required.
Therefore the petitioner is entitled to be released on bail.

In the result, this application is allowed on the following conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall co-operate with the trial of the case.

(d) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.
(e) Petitioner shall not leave the country without the permission of the jurisdictional Court.

In case of violation of any of the above conditions or if any modification or deletion of the conditions are required, the jurisdictional Court shall be empowered to consider such applications, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.
